subject: Next steps: multi-time-zone deep dive + proposed rotation
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Tom Healey <tom.healey@aperturehealth.com>, Anika Patel <anika.patel@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Next steps: multi-time-zone deep dive + proposed rotation

Hi Tom / Anika —

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier today. Quick recap from our side: Aperture Health is evaluating a hosted + dedicated hybrid for inference run in US and EU regions with an on-prem option for certain regulated workloads. Your priorities are low-latency access for clinical apps, predictable unit costs, and clear security controls (audit logs, KMS).

Proposed next step: a 30–45 minute technical deep dive focused on deployment architecture, networking, and the ops experience (autoscaling, rollback, and fallbacks). To make scheduling straightforward for your cross-region team, we suggest setting up a rotating demo cadence so different weeks favor US / EU / APAC attendees rather than trying to find a single perfect slot.

Suggested rotation pattern (flexible):
- Week A (US-friendly): Tue or Wed morning ET / early afternoon PT (e.g. 10:00 ET / 07:00 PT)
- Week B (EU-friendly): Wed / Thu mid-afternoon CET (e.g. 15:00 CET)
- Week C (APAC-friendly): Thu / Fri evening JST / AEST (e.g. 20:00 JST)

For the immediate next meeting, can you indicate which of these windows works best for your engineers? If useful we can propose three specific candidate times next week and rotate thereafter. I attached a short agenda (redwood-demo-agenda-v1.pdf) with the topics and suggested owners.

Next steps from us: once you confirm preferred window we will:
- Lock a 30–45 minute slot and send a calendar invite
- Share pre-read (network diagram + security checklist)
- Loop in the engineering lead who will run the demo (Vivek will own the deep technical walk-through)

Possible next meeting dates we can seed with (all slots are 30–45 mins):
- Tue Jul 29 — US slot: 10:00 ET / 15:00 BST
- Wed Jul 30 — EU slot: 15:00 CET
- Thu Jul 31 — APAC slot: 20:00 JST

Please let me know which of the three windows works for you and who needs to attend from your side. Happy to work through constraints and make this a recurring cadence if you want to rotate weeks.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183
[Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 34KB)]

From: Tom Healey <tom.healey@aperturehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Anika Patel <anika.patel@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Next steps: multi-time-zone deep dive + proposed rotation

Sean —

Thanks for the clear recap. The team liked the idea of rotating windows; it’s hard for our global engineering group to attend the same slot each week. A couple of quick notes from our side:
- We’d prefer a 30-minute focused technical deep dive (architecture + networking + perf expectations) rather than a broader product demo.
- Some of our APAC contributors are in India and prefer earlier-than-20:00 JST if possible, but they can stretch for the first session.

For the three seed dates, the best fit for our cross-region team would be:
- Tue Jul 29: 15:00 BST / 10:00 ET — works for UK and US dev leads
- Wed Jul 30: 15:00 CET — works for EU folks
- Thu Jul 31: prefer 18:30 IST over 20:00 JST if you can slide it earlier

If you can propose a rotation where the first meeting is Jul 29 at 15:00 BST, that would be ideal. Please include a calendar invite and a short pre-read for network/topology questions.

Tom Healey
Director of Infrastructure | Aperture Health
Tom.Healey@aperturehealth.com | +44 20 7946 0800

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Tom Healey <tom.healey@aperturehealth.com>, Anika Patel <anika.patel@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 13:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps: multi-time-zone deep dive + proposed rotation

Tom —

Appreciate the quick reply and the preference for Jul 29. We can absolutely run a concise 30-minute technical deep dive. To address the APAC timing note, here’s a concrete rotation proposal that keeps each weekly meeting ~30 minutes and rotates the favorability across regions: 

Rotation cadence (example 6-week cycle):
- Week 1 (US window): Tue 10:00 ET / 15:00 BST — 30 mins (engineering + product)
- Week 2 (EU window): Wed 15:00 CET — 30 mins (platform + security)
- Week 3 (APAC window): Thu 18:30 IST / 20:00 JST — 30 mins (ops + on-prem questions)
- Week 4 back to US window, etc.

Operational details we’ll handle:
- Send recurring calendar invites with a rotating title (e.g., "Aperture Health — Redwood Technical Deep Dive (Week 1 — US)")
- Create a shared calendar label and a short invite description with pre-reads and the HubSpot link (see related link)
- Owner rotation: Vivek leads the technical demo; Lauren owns follow-up notes and action items; Marissa will coordinate materials/slides

For the first session on Jul 29 we’ll schedule:
- Date: Tue Jul 29
- Time: 15:00 BST / 10:00 ET
- Duration: 30 minutes
- Agenda highlights: brief architecture Q&A, expected latency/throughput, data isolation options, next steps and rollouts

I’ll draft the invite and share the pre-read (redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf) shortly. If you want me to nudge an alternative earlier for APAC on Jul 31 (18:30 IST), say so and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks — locking Jul 29 pending your confirmation.

Sean

[Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf (application/pdf, 36KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: multi-time-zone deep dive + proposed rotation

Sean / team —

Quick note: Vivek can lead the deep-dive on Jul 29 and I’ll put together a two-slide topology + a short runbook for the pre-read. Vivek, can you confirm you’re good to lead the 10:00 ET slot?

Also proposing the following three recurring dates to seed the calendar (so we don’t have to re-synch each time):
- Jul 29 2025 — Week 1 (US)
- Aug 5 2025 — Week 2 (EU)
- Aug 12 2025 — Week 3 (APAC)

If everyone is aligned I’ll create the recurring invite (3 occurrences for the pilot) and add the agenda + HubSpot link to the invite.

Marissa Cole
Manager, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 212-555-0126

Subject: Re: Next steps: multi-time-zone deep dive + proposed rotation

Sean / Marissa —

Jul 29 at 15:00 BST (10:00 ET) works for us. Vivek leading is perfect — please include our infrastructure lead (Anika Patel) and myself on the invite. A short pre-read on network topology and the security checklist would be helpful ahead of the meeting.

We’re good with the three-date pilot (Jul 29 / Aug 5 / Aug 12) and the rotation approach — thanks for making scheduling easy. Please go ahead and send the calendar invites and the pre-read.

Tom
